term: causal power as actual modeled exercise or transmission
definition: In the #319 Profile, m.transmitsPower w y x records a power transmitted from an existing source y to an existing target x in the selected world and power channel; Coherent additionally requires that y causes x there. A specific source-to-effect edge is required by Boundary. This is modeled causal activity, not a full account of physical production, temporal process, intrinsic potency or esse.
note: The Profile uses an actual link, as opposed to a merely unexercised capacity. Since the formalism abstracts over time and chooses one relation as the respect, further claims about simultaneously exercised per-se efficacy or the cause of the exercise remain open.
